commits.body:
Mechanical setup for llm-dlc/loops/in-the-loop-classpath-and-entry-discovery-brief.md, recorded in its -setup.md. Every input the brief reuses was checked by digest at the path its reader uses: the Log4j #1173 api/core jars, the 113-entry Parquet J08 graphs, the 21 semantics-gap graphs (283 bindings), and the scaffold-first records (372/372 archives). The 480 release-panel packet jars were chained to signed Ubuntu indexes, and the original /usr/share/java layouts of slots 03, 04, 08, 10, 13, 15 and 16 were extracted to ~/.cache/in-the-loop/classpath-entry-discovery/layouts. The OpenJDK jdk-21+35 ClassPath.java fixture was fetched into the jdk21u mirror.

Verified on JDK 21: the OpenJDK A.jar/B.zip manifest cycle (6/6 as the test expects), the Log4j getNextTime rows and PatternProcessor origins on the built jars in api-then-core order, and the ten J08 physical observations (10/10). Examples 312, 323 and 333 validate, the class-binding tests pass, and jvmcontract was rebuilt at this head. No verification job was needed. Product runs, generated layouts and scoring are left to the domain work.
